points.statement: The model should dynamically assemble restoration parameters conditioned on the input image and apply them at token level, rather than selecting static experts or using a global condition.
points.quote: Instead of selecting from a static set of experts or modulating the network with a single global condition, the model should dynamically assemble restoration parameters conditioned on the input image and apply them at the token level.

points.statement: Instead of pooling features into a global descriptor, the adapter uses learnable queries to probe spatial contexts and decode routing bases and residual directions.
points.quote: Rather than pooling intermediate features into a single global descriptor, the adapter uses learnable queries to probe condensed spatial contexts and decode them into routing bases and residual directions.

points.statement: Every spatial token assembles an additive residual update through dense signed dot-product affinities over generated rank-wise components.
points.quote: Each spatial token then assembles its own additive residual update through dense signed dot-product affinities over these generated rank-wise components.

points.statement: Assembled residual updates are injected into attention projections of the restoration backbone so spatial feature interactions adapt to each image's degradation structure.
points.quote: The assembled residual updates are injected into the attention projections of the restoration backbone, allowing spatial feature interactions to adapt to the degradation structure of each image.

points.statement: The token-wise residual is expressed as a dot-product interaction between spatial tokens and synthesized routing bases, then a weighted combination of residual directions.
points.quote: The token-wise residual can be written as a dot-product interaction between spatial tokens and dynamically synthesized routing bases, followed by a weighted combination of synthesized residual directions.

points.statement: Spatial tokens act as queries, while generated routing bases and residual directions play roles analogous to keys and values.
points.quote: In this form, spatial tokens serve as queries, while the generated routing bases and residual directions play roles analogous to keys and values.

points.statement: The assembly rule admits a linear-attention perspective that makes its dense token-wise routing behavior transparent.
points.quote: The resulting assembly rule also admits a linear-attention perspective, making its dense token-wise routing behavior transparent.

points.statement: This formulation suits compositional degradations because different spatial tokens can receive different residual updates while sharing a compact input-conditioned parameter space.
points.quote: This formulation is particularly suitable for compositional degradations, where different spatial tokens can receive different residual updates while sharing a compact and efficient input-conditioned parameter space.

points.statement: A needed mechanism should be input-adaptive and spatially adaptive without collapsing the image into a global descriptor or limiting adaptation to static expert parameters.
points.quote: What remains missing is a mechanism that is both input-adaptive and spatially adaptive, without collapsing the image into a global descriptor or restricting adaptation to static expert parameters.
